item.title: Golf: Vani To Make First Start In 2026 As Jasmine Seeks Another Win On WPG Tour
item.description: Bombay Presidency Golf Club: Vani Kapoor will make her first start this week in the second leg of the Women’s Pro Golf Tour (WPG) Tour at the Kalhaar Blues & Greens in Ahmedabad, Gujarat, on Tuesday. After missing the season-opener, Vani, who won five times last year while topping the WPG Order of Merit, will feature in the event alongside some of the other leading names.

item.title: Jemimah Rodrigues’ Unbeaten 51 Powers Delhi Capitals Past Mumbai Indians in WPL 2026
item.description: Skipper Jemimah Rodrigues’ calm unbeaten 51 and a solid opening stand from Lizelle Lee helped Delhi Capitals beat Mumbai Indians by seven wickets in the WPL 2026 clash at Vadodara, despite a fighting 65* from Nat Sciver-Brunt.

item.title: Real Madrid Thrash Monaco, Sporting Stun PSG In Champions League
item.description: Paris Saint Germain: Kylian Mbappe scored twice against one of his former clubs as Real Madrid eased past Monaco 6-1 at home to boost its chances of finishing in the top eight of the Champions League league phase.

item.title: WPL: Harmanpreet Kaur Admits Mumbai Indians Fell 20 Runs Short After Loss to Delhi Capitals
item.description: Mumbai Indians skipper Harmanpreet Kaur blamed poor Power-play execution after her team suffered a seven-wicket defeat to Delhi Capitals in the WPL, admitting they were 20 runs short despite strong knocks from Nat Sciver-Brunt and herself.

item.title: Champions League: Arsenal Guarantee Top-8 Finish With Milan Win; Spurs Beat Dortmund
item.description: Jens Petter Hauge: Gabriel Jesus's first Champions League goals since November 2023 helped Arsenal win 3-1 over Inter Milan to make it eight victories from eight and guaranteed a top-two finish in this season’s Champions League.

item.title: Jemimah Praises Kapp After DC’s WPL Win
item.description: Delhi Capitals captain Jemimah Rodrigues praised Marizanne Kapp’s outstanding Powerplay spell after DC’s commanding win over Mumbai Indians in WPL 2026, highlighted by Rodrigues’ match-winning half-century and a disciplined bowling performance.

item.title: Sabalenka Eases Into Australian Open Third Round
item.description: Australian Open: World No. 1 Aryna Sabalenka eased into the third round of the Australian Open after beating Chinese qualifier Bai Zhuoxuan 6-3, 6-1 in 32 minutes on Wednesday.

item.title: ICC Chair Jay Shah Meets Africa Cricket Association Leaders In Windhoek; Attends U19 WC Match
item.description: T20 World Cup Africa Qualifier: International Cricket Council (ICC) chair Jay Shah met with leaders of the Africa Cricket Association in Windhoek and emphasised the ICC's commitment to expanding cricket across Africa.

item.title: Aus Open: Medvedev, Rublev Move Into Third Round In Melbourne
item.description: John Cain Arena: Daniil Medvedev was made to work for his place in the third round of the Australian Open, grinding out a 6-7(9), 6-3, 6-4, 6-2 victory over France’s Quentin Halys on Wednesday at John Cain Arena.

item.title: Good To See Jemimah Play Her Natural Game On Tough Wicket: Mithali
item.description: Royal Challengers Bengaluru: Former India captain Mithali Raj lauded Delhi Capitals’ recent win against Mumbai Indians and highlighted skipper Jemimah Rodrigues’ composed, match-winning knock under pressure while also assessing the tough road ahead for MI against an in-form Royal Challengers Bengaluru.
